steps.title: Dark‑adapt leaf disc plates
steps.instruction: Wrap each plate containing leaf discs in tin foil to prevent light exposure and keep in the dark for at least 1 hour (overnight is acceptable but may increase stress). This fully oxidises the photosynthetic electron transport chain and opens reaction centres; a properly adapted plant should show an Fv/Fm value of ~0.8 (values <0.7 indicate incomplete adaptation or stress).

steps.title: Power on equipment and launch software
steps.instruction: Turn on the computer and the CF Imager (switch on the top‑right of the machine). Open the FluorImager software from the desktop.

steps.title: Load measurement protocol
steps.instruction: Press the red ‘P’ button; when prompted, click ‘Yes’ to load the automatically supplied protocol. If a different protocol is required, go to Settings → ‘.pcl (protocol) files’ → ‘load files’ and select the desired .pcl file.

steps.title: Prepare plate for insertion
steps.instruction: In the dark, unwrap the foil, remove the plate lid, and verify each leaf disc is horizontal with the underside facing down (use tweezers with no sharp edges if needed). Place the plate into the imaging chamber, centre it, and secure its position with tape to mark the centre of the raised platform. Optionally, use a dummy plate with leaf discs to check the correct height before inserting the real plate.

steps.title: Set platform height
steps.instruction: Rotate the height‑controller knob to raise or lower the platform so that the leaf surface is approximately 140 mm from the base of the imaging chamber. Estimate an average height for the leaf discs and set the platform accordingly.

steps.title: Adjust aperture for optimal illumination
steps.instruction: Manually adjust the aperture (as shown in the instrument diagram) to allow enough light for measurement without over‑exposing the leaf discs.

steps.title: Set optical focus
steps.instruction: Turn the focus dial located above the chamber to bring the leaf discs into sharp focus, then lock the position by tightening the side screw.

steps.title: Isolate leaf discs in software
steps.instruction: In FluorImager, click ‘Image’ then ‘Apply Image Isolation’ to generate an image where each leaf disc is distinct; background areas will be masked in blue.

steps.title: Run the protocol and monitor progress
steps.instruction: Start the protocol (it begins automatically after loading). Watch the on‑screen progress bar: a green line indicates the protocol is running, a red line indicates it has stopped.

steps.title: Export measurement data
steps.instruction: When the protocol finishes, click ‘File’ → ‘Save As’, choose a folder, and give the file a descriptive name to save the data.
